title: Exterior product in cohomology with closed support
statement:
Let $Z\subset X,W\subset Y$ be closed subschemes of
separated finite-type
schemes over an algebraically closed field $k$. Fix a finite
commutative coefficient ring $A$, and let $K,L$ be bounded-below
complexes of $A$-module sheaves on their etale sites whose
derived exterior product
is bounded below. The *supported exterior product* is the map

$$
\kappa^{Z,W}_{K,L}:
R\Gamma_Z(X,K)\otimes_A^LR\Gamma_W(Y,L)
\longrightarrow
R\Gamma_{Z\times W}(X\times_kY,K\boxtimes_A^L L).
$$

It is obtained by pulling back sections in the two factors and
tensoring them: their supports meet in $Z\times W$.
Derive this pairing with K-flat tensor and injective support
resolutions. Thus its composition with the map forgetting support
is the ordinary exterior product,
and its cohomology uses the
support functors.

lean.statement: def supportedExteriorProduct (A : Type (u + 1)) [CommRing A] {B X Y Z W : Scheme.{u}} (f : X ⟶ B) (g : Y ⟶ B) (i : Z ⟶ X) (j : W ⟶ Y) [IsClosedImmersion i] [IsClosedImmersion j] (K : DerivedCategory (Sheaf X.smallEtaleTopology (ModuleCat.{u + 1} A))) (L : DerivedCategory (Sheaf Y.smallEtaleTopology (ModuleCat.{u + 1} A))) : (supportedSectionsDerived A i).obj K ⊗ (supportedSectionsDerived A j).obj L ⟶ (supportedSectionsDerived A (supportedProductImmersion f g i j)).obj (externalProduct (ModuleCat.{u + 1} A) f g K L)
lean.note: The dependency has no recorded Lean declaration. This module constructs the canonical supported product as the adjoint of the coefficient tensor comparison followed by pulled-back support evaluation counits. All choices are uniquely normalized on ordinary quotient sections and signed total-complex representatives. The unbounded construction restricts to the source bounded-below case.
